metadata.description: Red tiles form a geometric raised-arm figure inspired by pysanka motifs. Blue ground slows the craft; red ground is lethal until captured. Open constellation surround the motif, with braided channels along the lower route. 5 yellow bouncers, two outer patrols and 7 island-contour patrols guard the field. No horizontal barrier bars. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%.
